descriptions.d24d_acquire_message_80162024: Clears the out reference, takes the last message of the free pool 0x80455244 (0x80004005 if empty), retains it in the out reference, sets owner (+4), id (+8) and active (+16); tests the sender's class against three class records via the base link (+20) to select a per-id list table and appends the message, returning 0; unknown class returns 0x80004005.
